Market today: The market is treading water, fixated on Treasury yields and Kevin Warsh's Jackson Hole speech, which could set the tone for interest rates. Geopolitical tensions (Iran war stalemate, US-China rhetoric) are background noise but could impact risk sentiment, especially for your tech-heavy, margin-fueled book.

Your holdings: SOXL is a major concern, down over 50% and marked "SELL" – its leveraged nature amplifies drops. SPAL, a brand-new leveraged ETF, is also down significantly at -39.28%. Margin amplifies these drawdowns.

Watch: Keep a close eye on Treasury yield movements post-Jackson Hole. Also, monitor any escalation in US-China rhetoric, as it directly impacts your tech/chip names.

Bottom line: Focus on managing risk in your leveraged, underperforming positions while staying alert to macro shifts.
plays: Consider trimming SOXL given its "SELL" status, -51.65% loss, and leveraged decay. Re-evaluate its default stop at 200.
Review SPAL, a new leveraged ETF down -39.28%. Its default stop at 21.38 needs attention due to its fast-moving nature.
Consider adding to CRWD (ACCUMULATE on scanner) on positive AI news, with an entry between 223.95-222.7 and stop at 220.23.
